output_dir.description: The output folder: must not lie inside the data folder or a git working tree.

plugins.description: Plugin file names in load order, masters first.

worlds.description: Worlds to generate (editor ids); empty means every world with terrain.

Inclusion.description: Which objects enter object LOD, beyond the game's own rule (visible when distant).

exclude_models.description:
Leave out models whose path (relative to `meshes`, lower case, forward slashes) matches one of these
patterns; `*` matches any run of characters.

exclude_plugins.description: Leave out objects whose reference or base object comes from one of these plugins (file names).

exclude_records.description: Leave out these records: absolute `FormID`s of a reference or a base object, eight hex digits.

only_plugins.description: When not empty, keep only objects whose reference or base object comes from one of these plugins.

diffuse_size.description: Edge of the diffuse map in pixels, a power of two from 4 to 4096.

max_vertices.description: Vertex cap per block mesh, 3 to 32767.

normal_size.description: Edge of the normal map in pixels, a power of two from 4 to 4096.

quality.description: Quality: the allowed vertical error is twice this many world units.

memory_mib.description: A memory budget in MiB, advisory: the run refuses early when the plugins alone are expected to need more.

threads.description: Worker threads; omitted means the machine decides (at most four).

drop_under_terrain.description:
Leave out object faces that lie wholly under the ground (all three corners below the terrain at their
position). Off by default; written only when on.

drop_under_water.description:
Leave out object faces that lie wholly under the water of a cell that has water. Off by default; written
only when on.

land_textures.description: Blend the land textures into the diffuse maps (off: vertex colours only).

levels.description: Levels; empty means the defaults (4, 8, 16 and 32).

texture_scales.description:
How often a land texture repeats across a cell quadrant in the diffuse maps, by the land texture's absolute
`FormID` (eight hex digits); a texture not listed repeats once. Empty by default; written only when set.

water.description: Write water planes into the terrain blocks that have ground below water.

enabled.description:
Write tree LOD: billboard atlas, type list and block files. Needs billboard textures that mods ship in
the data folder (see docs/spec/object-lod.md); a world without any gets no tree LOD.
